*Saraṇaduka, Sekkhattika* is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection. Methodologically, it analyzes the conditional relations arising from the intersection of the *saraṇaduka* (the dyad regarding defilement or fault) and the *sekkhattika* (the triad regarding learners/trainees, those adept beyond training, and those who are neither).

 However, computational text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus demonstrates considerable internal reuse within the *Paṭṭhāna*, detecting 82 matching passages shared across 38 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most extensive textual correspondence occurs with *Saraṇaduka, Dassanenapahātabbadukādi* (Patthana 18.29), particularly between segments §1.1–3.1 and §1.1–3.1 [DharmaNexus]. Additional substantial overlaps are found with *Saraṇaduka, Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 24.22, where segments §2.1–3.1 correspond to §1.1–2.1), *Nahetusahetukaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.26), *Saraṇaduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.14), *Tika Saraṇaduka* (Patthana 4.8), as well as neighbouring sections of chapter 15 including *Saraṇaduka, Upādinnattika* (Patthana 15.73) and *Saraṇaduka, Hīnattika* (Patthana 15.83) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus registers no cross-language matches meeting its similarity threshold [DharmaNexus].
